```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
cert_files <- list.files(
  "epc",
  pattern = "certificates.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
epc_cert <- bind_rows(lapply(cert_files, read_csv))
```
```{r}
dim(epc_cert)
```

```{r}
write.csv(epc_cert,"epc_cert.csv")
```

```{r}
names(epc_cert)
```
```{r}
# Keep only essential EPC fields for merging and modelling
epc_small <- epc_cert %>%
  transmute(
    lmk_key = LMK_KEY,
    postcode = POSTCODE,
    lodgement_date = as.Date(LODGEMENT_DATE),
    paon_epc = ADDRESS1,
    street_epc = ADDRESS2,
    current_energy_rating = CURRENT_ENERGY_RATING,
    current_energy_efficiency = CURRENT_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY,
    total_floor_area = TOTAL_FLOOR_AREA,
    built_form = BUILT_FORM,
    construction_age_band = CONSTRUCTION_AGE_BAND
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(postcode), postcode != "", !is.na(lodgement_date))
```

```{r}
names(epc_small)
```

```{r}
write.csv(epc_small,"epc_small.csv")
```

```{r}
epc_cert <- epc_cert %>%
  mutate(
    saon_clean    = str_extract(ADDRESS1, "\\d+"),  # flat number from ADDRESS1
    paon_clean    = str_extract(ADDRESS2, "^\\d+"), # building number from ADDRESS2
    postcode      = trimws(toupper(POSTCODE))
  )
```

```{r}
epc_cert %>%
  filter(!is.na(ADDRESS2)) %>%
  mutate(saon_clean = str_extract(ADDRESS1, "\\d+")) %>%
  select(ADDRESS1, saon_clean) %>%
  sample_n(20)
```

```{r}
# EPC: same logic on ADDRESS1
epc_cert %>%
  filter(!is.na(ADDRESS2)) %>%
  mutate(
    saon_clean = str_extract(
      toupper(ADDRESS1),
      "(?<=FLAT |APARTMENT |UNIT )([\\dA-Z]+)"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(ADDRESS1, saon_clean) %>%
  sample_n(20)
```


```{r}
names(epc_cert)
```
```{r}
epc_clean <- epc_cert %>%
  mutate(
    postcode   = trimws(toupper(POSTCODE)),
    saon_clean = str_extract(toupper(ADDRESS1), "(?<=FLAT |APARTMENT |UNIT )([\\dA-Z]+)"),
    paon_clean = trimws(toupper(str_extract(ADDRESS2, "^\\d+")))
  ) %>%
  select(
    # ── Join keys ──────────────────────────────────
    lmk_key               = LMK_KEY,
    postcode,
    saon_clean,
    paon_clean,
    lodgement_date        = LODGEMENT_DATE,

    # ── EPC rating ─────────────────────────────────
    current_energy_rating    = CURRENT_ENERGY_RATING,
    current_energy_efficiency = CURRENT_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY,
    potential_energy_rating  = POTENTIAL_ENERGY_RATING,
    potential_energy_efficiency = POTENTIAL_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY,

    # ── Energy costs ───────────────────────────────
    heating_cost_current  = HEATING_COST_CURRENT,
    heating_cost_potential = HEATING_COST_POTENTIAL,
    hot_water_cost_current = HOT_WATER_COST_CURRENT,
    lighting_cost_current = LIGHTING_COST_CURRENT,

    # ── Physical characteristics ───────────────────
    property_type         = PROPERTY_TYPE,
    built_form            = BUILT_FORM,
    construction_age_band = CONSTRUCTION_AGE_BAND,
    total_floor_area      = TOTAL_FLOOR_AREA,
    number_habitable_rooms = NUMBER_HABITABLE_ROOMS,
    floor_level           = FLOOR_LEVEL,
    flat_storey_count     = FLAT_STOREY_COUNT,
    walls_description     = WALLS_DESCRIPTION,
    roof_description      = ROOF_DESCRIPTION,
    windows_description   = WINDOWS_DESCRIPTION,
    mainheat_description  = MAINHEAT_DESCRIPTION,
    main_fuel             = MAIN_FUEL,
    mains_gas_flag        = MAINS_GAS_FLAG
  )
```

```{r}
write.csv(epc_clean,"epc_clean.csv")
```

```{r}
# 2. How many EPC records have a valid paon_clean?
epc_clean %>%
  summarise(
    has_paon_clean = sum(!is.na(paon_clean) & paon_clean != ""),
    no_paon_clean  = sum(is.na(paon_clean) | paon_clean == "")
  )
```

```{r}
# 3. Spot check — do the join keys actually align?
ppd_flats %>% select(postcode, saon_clean, paon_clean) %>% sample_n(10)
epc_flats %>% select(postcode, saon_clean, paon_clean) %>% sample_n(10)
```
```{r}
# FLATS: postcode + saon_clean only (paon_clean too unreliable)
flats_joined <- ppd_flats %>%
  left_join(epc_flats, by = c("postcode", "saon_clean"))

# HOUSES: postcode + paon_clean (houses are more reliable)
houses_joined <- ppd_houses %>%
  left_join(epc_houses, by = c("postcode", "paon_clean"))

# COMBINE
merged <- bind_rows(flats_joined, houses_joined)

# CHECK MATCH RATE
merged %>%
  summarise(
    total      = n(),
    matched    = sum(!is.na(lmk_key)),
    unmatched  = sum(is.na(lmk_key)),
    match_rate = round(matched / total * 100, 1)
  )
```

```{r}
# 1. Check for duplicates - are transactions being multiplied?
merged %>%
  count(transaction_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  summarise(
    duplicated_transactions = n(),
    total_duplicate_rows = sum(n)
  )
```

```{r}
# 2. Check row counts at each stage
nrow(ppd_clean)
nrow(ppd_flats)
nrow(ppd_houses)
nrow(flats_joined)
nrow(houses_joined)
nrow(merged)
```

```{r}
# Keep only the most recent EPC per postcode + saon_clean
epc_flats_deduped <- epc_flats %>%
  arrange(postcode, saon_clean, desc(lodgement_date)) %>%
  group_by(postcode, saon_clean) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Same for houses
epc_houses_deduped <- epc_houses %>%
  arrange(postcode, paon_clean, desc(lodgement_date)) %>%
  group_by(postcode, paon_clean) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Re-run joins with deduped EPC
flats_joined <- ppd_flats %>%
  left_join(epc_flats_deduped, by = c("postcode", "saon_clean"))

houses_joined <- ppd_houses %>%
  left_join(epc_houses_deduped, by = c("postcode", "paon_clean"))

# Combine
merged <- bind_rows(flats_joined, houses_joined)

# Check
merged %>%
  summarise(
    total      = n(),
    matched    = sum(!is.na(lmk_key)),
    unmatched  = sum(is.na(lmk_key)),
    match_rate = round(matched / total * 100, 1)
  )
```
```{r}
# 1. How many flats vs houses matched?
flats_joined %>%
  summarise(

    match_rate = round(matched / total * 100, 1)
  )
```



```{r}
# What does paon_clean look like in EPC houses?
epc_houses_deduped %>%
  select(postcode, paon_clean) %>%
  sample_n(20)
```

```{r}
epc_houses_deduped <- epc_cert %>%
  mutate(
    postcode   = trimws(toupper(POSTCODE)),
    saon_clean = str_extract(toupper(ADDRESS1), "(?<=FLAT |APARTMENT |UNIT )([\\dA-Z]+)"),
    paon_clean = trimws(str_extract(toupper(ADDRESS1), "^\\d+"))  # from ADDRESS1 for houses
  ) %>%
  filter(is.na(saon_clean), !is.na(paon_clean)) %>%
  select(
    lmk_key                     = LMK_KEY,
    postcode, saon_clean, paon_clean,
    lodgement_date              = LODGEMENT_DATE,
    current_energy_rating       = CURRENT_ENERGY_RATING,
    current_energy_efficiency   = CURRENT_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY,
    potential_energy_rating     = POTENTIAL_ENERGY_RATING,
    potential_energy_efficiency = POTENTIAL_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY,
    heating_cost_current        = HEATING_COST_CURRENT,
    heating_cost_potential      = HEATING_COST_POTENTIAL,
    hot_water_cost_current      = HOT_WATER_COST_CURRENT,
    lighting_cost_current       = LIGHTING_COST_CURRENT,
    property_type_epc           = PROPERTY_TYPE,
    built_form                  = BUILT_FORM,
    construction_age_band       = CONSTRUCTION_AGE_BAND,
    total_floor_area            = TOTAL_FLOOR_AREA,
    number_habitable_rooms      = NUMBER_HABITABLE_ROOMS,
    floor_level                 = FLOOR_LEVEL,
    flat_storey_count           = FLAT_STOREY_COUNT,
    walls_description           = WALLS_DESCRIPTION,
    roof_description            = ROOF_DESCRIPTION,
    windows_description         = WINDOWS_DESCRIPTION,
    mainheat_description        = MAINHEAT_DESCRIPTION,
    main_fuel                   = MAIN_FUEL,
    mains_gas_flag              = MAINS_GAS_FLAG
  ) %>%
  arrange(postcode, paon_clean, desc(lodgement_date)) %>%
  group_by(postcode, paon_clean) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Re-run house join
houses_joined <- ppd_houses %>%
  left_join(epc_houses_deduped, by = c("postcode", "paon_clean"))

# Check house match rate
houses_joined %>%
  summarise(
    total      = n(),
    matched    = sum(!is.na(lmk_key)),
    match_rate = round(matched / total * 100, 1)
  )
```

```{r}
# Combine flats and houses
merged <- bind_rows(flats_joined, houses_joined)

# Final match rate
merged %>%
  summarise(
    total      = n(),
    matched    = sum(!is.na(lmk_key)),
    unmatched  = sum(is.na(lmk_key)),
    match_rate = round(matched / total * 100, 1)
  )
```
```{r}
merged %>%
  count(transaction_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  nrow()
```

```{r}
write.csv(merged, "london_epc_ppd_merged.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
